subject: mathematics
question_text: If f: R→R, g: R→R are defined by f(x) = 3x − 1 and g(x) = x² + 1, then find (fog)(2).

verification.note: Source: Baby Bullet-Q, Junior Inter Maths-1A (Sri Publishers, Machilipatnam), book p.79 — VSAQ chapter 14 Functions, question 88. The book prints NO internal mark split on its VSAQ pages (unlike its LAQ/SAQ pages): the 1+1 across the two steps is our division of the 2 marks, not the source's. Appearance years are the book's, board-split. Publisher's claims until a Telangana IPE teacher confirms them.

recall_prompt: Say how you would find (fog)(2) — which function acts first, and the value.

page_header: Section A — Very Short Answer Question

steps.label: Work the inner function
steps.margin_note: One mark for getting inside first. g is the inner function in fog, so g(2) is computed before f touches anything.
steps.memory_tip: In fog, g is the INNER function, so g(2) is worked out before f touches anything.

recall.must_convey: That in fog the INNER function is g, so g(2) is worked first, giving 5.
accept: in f o g the inner function is g so first find g of two which is four plus one equals five
g of two is two squared plus one that is five
work g first because it is written second and acts first
modata g of two teeskovali adi five
the inner function g gives five at x equals two

steps.why: In fog the function written on the RIGHT acts first. Getting that order wrong changes the answer, so the examiner can see it in this line alone.
common_mistakes: Applying f first, which computes gof and gives a different number.
Reading g(2) as 2² + 1 = 5 but then substituting 2 again into f.

steps.label: Finish with the outer function
steps.margin_note: The second mark is the number. Put g(2) into f and simplify to a single value.
steps.memory_tip: Put g(2) = 5 into f: 3(5) − 1 = 14. The answer is one number.

recall.must_convey: That f is applied to 5, giving 3 times 5 minus 1, which is 14.
accept: f of five is three times five minus one equals fourteen
then apply f to five and get fourteen
three into five is fifteen minus one is fourteen
f of five ante fifteen minus one fourteen

steps.why: The outer function receives the inner function's OUTPUT, not the original 2. Writing f(5) makes that visible.
common_mistakes: Writing f(2) instead of f(5) at the last step.
